introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: Welcome to Académie des Éleveurs ("we", "our", or "us"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you visit our website and use our services.
introduction.paragraph2: By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our services.

personalInfo.heading: Personal information
personalInfo.intro: We may collect the following types of personal information:
items: Name and contact details (email address, phone number)
Account credentials (username, password)
Payment information (credit card details, billing address)
Professional information (veterinary license number, clinic information)
Purchase history and transaction records

autoInfo.heading: Information collected automatically
autoInfo.intro: When you visit our website, we automatically collect certain information:
items: IP address and device information
Browser type and version
Pages visited and time spent on pages
Referring website addresses
Cookies and similar tracking technologies

howWeUse.title: How we use your information
howWeUse.intro: We use the information collected for the following purposes:
items: Providing, maintaining, and improving our services
Processing transactions and sending related information
Sending administrative information and updates
Responding to your inquiries and providing customer support
Sending marketing communications (with your consent)
Detecting, preventing, and resolving technical issues
Complying with legal obligations and enforcing our terms
Protecting the rights, property, and safety of our users

informationSharing.title: Sharing and disclosure of information
informationSharing.intro: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may only share your information under the following circumstances:

serviceProviders.heading: Service providers
serviceProviders.body: We may share information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing, data analysis, and email delivery.

legalRequirements.heading: Legal requirements
legalRequirements.body: We may disclose information if required by law or in response to valid requests from public authorities.

businessTransfers.heading: Business transfers
businessTransfers.body: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your information may be transferred to the acquiring entity.

dataSecurity.title: Data security
dataSecurity.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:
items: 256-bit SSL encryption for data transmission
Secure server infrastructure with regular security audits
Access controls and authentication mechanisms
Regular backups and disaster recovery procedures
Data handling practices aligned with HIPAA standards
dataSecurity.disclaimer: No method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

cookies.title: Cookies and tracking technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and store certain information.

items.label: Essential cookies:
items.text: Necessary for the website to function properly

items.label: Analytics cookies:
items.text: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site

cookies.outro: You can set your browser to refuse all cookies. However, some features of the site may no longer work properly.

yourRights.title: Your rights and choices
yourRights.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

items.label: Access:
items.text: Request access to your personal information

items.label: Deletion:
items.text: Request deletion of your personal information

items.label: Objection:
items.text: Object to the processing of your personal information

items.label: Portability:
items.text: Request the transfer of your data to another service

items.label: Withdrawal:
items.text: Withdraw your consent to data processing

yourRights.outro: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below.

dataRetention.title: Data retention
dataRetention.paragraph1: We will only retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.
dataRetention.paragraph2: When we no longer need your personal information, we will securely delete or anonymize it in accordance with our data retention policies.

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's privacy
childrenPrivacy.paragraph1: Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

internationalTransfers.title: International data transfers
internationalTransfers.paragraph1: Your information may be transferred to and maintained on computers located outside your country, where data protection laws may differ from those of your jurisdiction.
internationalTransfers.paragraph2: By using our services, you consent to the transfer of your information. We will take all reasonably necessary steps to ensure that your data is treated securely in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.paragraph1: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
changes.paragraph2: You are advised to review this Policy periodically for any changes. Changes take effect as soon as they are posted on this page.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.paragraph1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us using the details shown below.

contactCard.heading: Questions about this policy?
contactCard.subtext: Our team is available to answer any of your questions.

privacy.closingNote: By using our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

banner.text: By using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use the Service.

acceptance.paragraph1: By accessing and using the Académie des Éleveurs website and services, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.
